policy.note: This registry gates only the Core Fixed-Record Writer-Gate Batch. Startup shell files and map, encounter, monster-template, and shop families are intentionally excluded.

gates.preservationPolicy: Fresh and authored messages compile the complete 256-byte row from canonical text without rawBytes. Unchanged imported rows and malformed file tails are preserved only from the compatibility annex at export.

Fresh and authored option labels compile the complete 25-byte row from canonical text without rawBytes. Unchanged imported rows and malformed file tails are preserved only from the compatibility annex at export. The blocked Strings Sound affordance is not part of this writer gate.
This gate covers Data DES description text only; monster templates and alternate monster sets stay outside this fixed-record batch.

Fresh treasure records compile all 48 bytes from twenty item IDs and four reward words without rawBytes. Imported records recompile from decoded semantics; only malformed file tails remain compatibility-annex data.

Fresh and authored battle records compile all 346 bytes from canonical semantics, including deterministic zero alignment padding, without rawBytes. Unchanged imported rows and malformed file tails are preserved only from the compatibility annex. Monster template writers and encounter routing stay outside this batch.
This gate covers timed encounters only; thief encounter records remain outside this batch.
This gate covers Data CI contact/release text only; marker/main startup shell files stay outside this batch.
This gate covers the optional Data RI restriction record only; marker/main party level fields stay outside this batch.
This gate proves fixed-row Global storage and source-backed hook slots. Reserved slots stay preserve-only until broader Divinity labels are proven.
